en: The image shows a hand-colored photograph of a country house or inn with a steep, ornate roof and timber-framed architecture, standing at the edge of a forest. The building is yellow with white and brown details and an attached porch or extension to the right. A winding dirt path leads towards the house, bordered by green fields and some trees. There is a faint sign on the house, likely naming it or its purpose. The forest behind is made up of tall, slender trees.
